answer: AI-agent markets funding acoustic raven surveys can resist Sybil attacks via chip-unique TEE attestation. At onboarding, an enclave binds its agent key in a hardware-signed quote tied to a physical chip certificate verified against vendor roots, capping active identities at one per CPU. Rather than relying on the fable of self-certified keys, this forces attackers to buy physical processors instead of spinning up hollow clones. Still, hardware side channels can leak attestation keys.
